# Virallized Reviews

> Review record and full customer-question reference for Virallized, an Instagram
> audience-growth service operating since 2017. Operated by Virallized.
> Every third-party figure links to its source.

## Key facts (verified 10 October 2026)

- Trustpilot rating: 4.8/5 ("Excellent") from 98 reviews; 97% five-star
- Trustpilot profile claimed May 2021; 33 reviews in the last 12 months
- Founded 2017 (9 years); 12,000+ clients served; reviewers span 21 countries
- Contact: support@virallized.com
- Method: targeted outreach performed manually by a real team, within Instagram's rules. No bots, no automation.
- Never posts to client accounts and never sends DMs on their behalf
- Account safety: no suspension attributable to the service anywhere in the 98-review record
- Pricing: $99 Standard / $149 Pro / $199 Max / $299 Managed per month; ~25% off annually
- Growth: 150–500 (Standard) to 750–3,000 (Managed) new followers per month
- First followers typically arrive within 48 hours; typical campaign 3–6 months
- Guarantee: 7-day money-back, no contract, cancel anytime
